authors: Yunxuan Li; Yibing Du; Jiageng Zhang; Le Hou; Peter Grabowski; Yeqing Li; Eugene Ie

authors: Carlos E. Jimenez; John Yang; Alexander Wettig; Shunyu Yao; Kexin Pei; Ofir Press; Karthik Narasimhan

authors: Islem Bouzenia; Premkumar Devanbu; Michael Pradel

title: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents
authors: Chunqiu Steven Xia; Yinlin Deng; Soren Dunn; Lingming Zhang
reason: Agentless's three deterministic phases and low cost are the crucial control condition against claims that open-ended autonomy is necessary.

title: CodaMOSA: Escaping Coverage Plateaus in Test Generation with Pre-trained Large Language Models
authors: Caroline Lemieux; Jeevana Priya Inala; Shuvendu K. Lahiri; Siddhartha Sen

title: CoverUp: Effective High Coverage Test Generation for Python
authors: Juan Altmayer Pizzorno; Emery D. Berger
reason: Iterative coverage feedback substantially improves generated tests and supplies a newer comparison to hybrid search-based testing.

title: QuickCheck: A Lightweight Tool for Random Testing of Haskell Programs
authors: Koen Claessen; John Hughes
reason: Foundational executable-property generator and counterexample framework; valuable background for asking why current agents rarely synthesize durable properties.

title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents

reason: Important open runtime and cross-task artifact; as a reading its broad platform evaluation isolates mechanisms less cleanly than SWE-agent or Agentless.

authors: Ziqian Zhong; Aditi Raghunathan; Nicholas Carlini

title: IRIS: LLM-Assisted Static Analysis for Detecting Security Vulnerabilities
authors: Ziyang Li; Saikat Dutta; Mayur Naik
reason: Uses the model to infer taint specifications and contextual facts while CodeQL preserves repository-scale dataflow reasoning and validates candidate flows.

authors: Yuqiang Sun; Daoyuan Wu; Yue Xue; Han Liu; Haijun Wang; Zhengzi Xu; Xiaofei Xie; Yang Liu

reason: Fine-grained component restart and separation of process from durable state offer concrete recovery abstractions missing from most current agent papers.

title: Crash-Only Software
authors: George Candea; Armando Fox
reason: Concise design thesis retained for provenance; Microreboot provides the stronger evaluated primary reading for this course.

authors: Edoardo Debenedetti; Jie Zhang; Mislav Balunovic; Luca Beurer-Kellner; Marc Fischer; Florian Tramer

authors: Jerome H. Saltzer; Michael D. Schroeder
reason: Complete mediation least privilege fail-safe defaults and capabilities supply the vocabulary missing from model-centric prompt-injection papers.

authors: Yu-Fu Fu; Meng Xu; Taesoo Kim
reason: Uses clause-specialized agents function inlining and Move Prover feedback to synthesize reusable preconditions postconditions and loop invariants.

authors: Xinyue Zuo; Yifan Zhang; Hongshu Wang; Yufan Cai; Zhe Hou; Jing Sun; Jin Song Dong
